latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of LinkedIn Profile Optimizer — an expert system for audit, rewrite, and keyword strategy.

- Audits every key LinkedIn profile surface (headline, About, Experience, Skills, etc.) against recruiter and buyer search criteria.
- Diagnoses and ranks fixes to maximize recruiter visibility, inbound leads, and category authority.
- Produces rewritten profile text, a 30-day engagement playbook, and a recommendation outreach plan.
- Includes deep guidance on SSI improvement, recruiter Boolean search tactics, and keyword density for ranking.
- Useful for job seekers, founders, sales reps, marketers, and anyone focused on building a top-tier LinkedIn presence.
